messages:
Maya (Partnerships): hey team — kicking off the integrator "train-the-trainer" pilot next month. want to align on curriculum, env access, and cert gating. who can drive the playbook draft?
Tom (Solutions Eng): I can own the hands-on labs and demo scenarios. will need a stable demo model + sample dataset.
Priya (Training): I'll draft the facilitator guide and 2-day agenda. prefer Wed/Thu slot for partner workshops.
Maya (Partnerships): @Tom good. @Priya do we have existing slide deck we can repurpose? also need to decide pass criteria for the cert.
Luca (Cert Lead): We should keep certification lightweight for pilot — practical checklist + one live lab assessment. suggested blueprint: lab (60%), quiz (25%), workshop participation (15%).
Janelle (Partner Success): FYI partners want hands-on access to a sandbox with dedicated capacity during training. can we offer Dedicated pilot credits?
Raj (Eng-Infra): we can provision a small dedicated pool in staging for the cohort. need partner account IDs and target dates. autoscale off to keep costs predictable.
Tom (Solutions Eng): sample dataset: anonymized ecomm queries + conversation turns. I'll prepare a small dataset and a runbook for the labs.
Priya (Training): facilitator guide outline: intro (30m), architecture deep-dive (45m), lab 1 (1h), lab 2 (1h), cert prep (30m), Q&A. want to include a short section on routing/fallback policies.
Maya (Partnerships): include marketplace packaging brief (how to list in cloud marketplaces) — partners asked about co-selling next quarter.
Luca (Cert Lead): exam logistics: proctored live lab via Zoom + evaluator checklist. we'll need 2 graders for pilot batch of 10. can we recruit SEs to help grade?
Tom (Solutions Eng): happy to grade a few. @Janelle can you confirm partner availability windows?
Janelle (Partner Success): reaching out to SI contacts today — will push a Doodle and send ETA by EOD.
Maya (Partnerships): action items so far: Tom = labs + dataset; Priya = facilitator guide + slides; Luca = cert blueprint + grading rubric; Raj = sandbox pool + account provisioning; Janelle = partner scheduling. please drop updates in this thread.
Raj (Eng-Infra): quick note on network: private deployment demo will require VPN tunnel setup for some partners. we can pre-stage an OpenVPN config. posting config snippet below:
```
# VPN pre-shared config
client
dev tun
proto udp
remote demo.redwood.local 1194
cipher AES-256-CBC
remote-cert-tls server
```
Tom (Solutions Eng): thanks Raj — we'll include connection steps in the runbook. also: recommend shipping a small cheat sheet for common troubleshooting commands and log locations.
Priya (Training): thinking of a short pre-read (15 min) on our serving runtime and caching model so trainees arrive prepared. will share draft by Tue.
Maya (Partnerships): timeline check: pilot cohort target week of 1719993600 (that's placeholder for May 20). can we lock resources?
Raj (Eng-Infra): yes, can provision for that week. need final partner list by 1719878400 (May 6).
Luca (Cert Lead): will prepare grading rubric template and a sample scored record for calibration.
Janelle (Partner Success): schedule poll sent. partners asked about hardware partner mentions in materials — can we include a slide on recommended GPU profiles?
Tom (Solutions Eng): add a short table: GPU type, batch sizes, expected p95 latency. I'll draft numbers with QA.
Maya (Partnerships): perfect. last thing — marketing would like a short co-announcement template for partners who complete certification. can someone draft a one-paragraph blurb?
Priya (Training): I'll toss a blurb into the shared drive and link it here when ready.
deploy-bot: note: staging cluster will be drained for maintenance on 1719462000-1719465600 UTC, avoid scheduling heavy jobs then. :warning:
Maya (Partnerships): ack. team — let's reconvene next Tue 11am PT. thanks all, big win if pilot goes well. :rocket:
